title: New revision references a ConfigMap key that does not exist

root_cause.summary: The latest checkout-api revision reads PAYMENTS_ENDPOINT from key payments-endpoint in ConfigMap app-config, which has no such key, so new pods fail with CreateContainerConfigError and the rollout stalls.

required_evidence: Pod events say the key payments-endpoint was not found in ConfigMap app-config
Deployment rollout history shows a new revision that is not progressing
red_herrings: Old pods from the previous revision are still Ready, so the service is up and partially degraded
The container image is fine; this is not an image or probe problem
fix: Add the payments-endpoint key to app-config (or remove the reference), or roll back to the previous revision with kubectl rollout undo.
